description:
RECEIPTS for your key (relays GET /api/v1/receipts/me): the price (10 J per receipt), whether THIS key is opted in, and how its
    owner turns them on. With receipts on, each paid graph answer comes with a receipt — the answer exactly as served, your query and its
    leaf in the anchored daily receipts root — kept in the key owner's ENYAL account, encrypted to the owner's keys, charged in the same
    debit as the answer (not charged if it could not be built). A key cannot opt itself in (it spends the owner's joules): the owner, signed
    in, uses PUT /api/v1/receipts/keys/{agent_id} {"enabled": true} or the key's card on greenlandai.ai. Verify a receipt free:
    POST /api/v1/verify/receipt. Free, not metered.
name: receipts_me

outputSchema.description: receipts_me — the calling key's receipt setting and the price (GET /api/v1/receipts/me).
outputSchema.title: ReceiptsMeOut
